HE FINALS, the world-famous, free-to-play, combat-centered game show! Fight alongside your teammates in virtual arenas that you can alter, exploit, and even destroy. Build your own playstyle in this first-person shooter to win escalating tournaments and lasting fame.

Love the game, they did remove a really good part of the game what should be implemented back: Unranked Tournaments. This was a good way for people to take the game serious and warm-up prior to actual Ranked games. With the removal of this mode, people can't find an alternative for a good warm-up. Quick cash is very much different to rank, since it's less rewarding, and there's almost no negatives to the gamemode (The fast respawn allows you to make mistakes and not think much about them). This negativity should be a motivator to play the game like it's supposed to, you should learn from your mistakes, you should work together in a team, it's a TEAM game! Personally i'm really disappointed to the fact they removed the core gamemode - UNRANKED TOURNAMENT-. Quick cash is a good mode, but it's just not enough for real enjoyers of the game. Ps. I wish i would be able to leave a positive recommendation to the game, but i think it's good to be critical.

THE FINALS is by far the best FPS I've ever played, and honestly probably one of the best games of all time.

Pros:
- Unique and fun core game mode (cashout)
- Highly unique loadout options
- Huge amount of loadout options & customization
- F2P Friendly battle pass & premium currency
- Amazing cosmetics
- Best construction in any FPS
- Map design
- Side game modes are great

Cons:
- Devs focus on balancing the meta & niche picks and ignore abysmally bad options for multiple seasons
- Third parties & griefing (in cashout)
- Very high skill ceiling & sweaty comp playerbase

I really want to like this game. The environments have so much destruction it's borderline insane, and the guns feel satisfying and fun to use. However, the Light class is frequently pampered by the devs and is one of the most tiresome things to fight in this game. The damage is better than the other classes, which makes sense since they're supposed to be the flanker/glass cannon. This quickly falls apart when one of they're abilities, the Dash, allows them to avoid damage on every press of a button; making them much harder to kill. The Light also has a double barrel shotgun, which has the fastest TTK in the game and it doesn't need headshots or backstabs to work. The shotgun has effectively no range past point blank, however, making it extremely high risk. The Dash covers a short distance very quickly, meaning a Light player can just press Q and cover a room's worth of distance instantly; killing an enemy heavy and dashing away with absolutely zero repercussions. None of this means the light is "too good" but it does mean that fighting Lights suck out the fun of the game and not worth anymore of my time.

The desync is just too much. This game is such a master piece, but it sits on a throne of shit which is the server performance. To make the physics work it simulates all aspects of each game server side, each client streams the key inputs to the server and the server simulates the results and send the results back to all clients, this results in all seeing the same things, but the delay between it all depends heavily on the server and client locations. This results in an incredibly spotty decync feel when you're the one with the worse connection.

The worst part is that this disproportionately affect certain weapons, for example bolt-action and melee weapons. These can become practically useless due to desync issues.

They also do not show any indicator equivalent to a ping or similar so you are left guessing how your connection currently is.

I so wish they are able to solve this at some point as when this game is working, it is the most fun fps ive seen in decades.

Hardware disclaimer: My rig is close to as good as money can buy, and i have an average norwegian internet speed/connection.

The game is a fun, fast-paced shooter.
Keep in mind that the following review is based on casual play, I very rarely play Ranked:
The game requires cooperation with your teammates; however, I don’t feel pressured to be on voice chat for my teammates to yell at me. I can play this game without voice chat and still enjoy it, which is a huge factor in keep things on the casual side and my mental health in check. There were only a handful of cases where someone was toxic in text chat, which is very positive for such a popular game.
Although there are slight balance issues with some of the classes, I can still recommend it. Monetization is cosmetic-only, so there is no disadvantage for free players, and the store offers a fair amount of customization.
